```{r setup, include= FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE)
```

```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(corrplot)

library(vip)
```

```{r read-data}
svrData <- read_csv("Scotland-Vulnerability-Resource_v0.2.csv")
glimpse(svrData)
summary(svrData)
```

```{r removeData}
dzData <- svrData %>%
    select(DEPRESS, Income_rate, Income_count, Employment_rate, Employment_count, CIF, EMERG, SIMD2020_Health_Domain_Rank) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    unique()

```

```{r data-split}
dzSplit <- dzData %>% initial_split(prop = 0.8, strata = DEPRESS)
dzTrain <- training(dzSplit)
dzTest <- testing(dzSplit)
```

```{r selecting-parameters}
dzCorr <- cor(dzTrain %>% select_if(is.numeric))
corrplot(dzCorr, tl.cex = 0.5)
```

```{r assumptions-lm}
 dzTrain %>% ggplot(aes(x = SIMD2020_Health_Domain_Rank, y = DEPRESS)) +
     geom_point()
```
